characters.name: Leo · 安保与展品管理员

lines.en: Before we open Riverside Hall, I must abstain from alcohol; my doctor says I am still recovering.
lines.zh: 河畔礼堂开放之前，我必须戒酒；医生说我还在康复中。

lines.en: I will abstain from voting on the catering contract because my sister owns one of the bidding companies.
lines.zh: 餐饮合同表决时我会弃权，因为其中一家竞标公司是我姐姐的。

lines.en: Good. The mayor promised in her inaugural address to revive this moribund cultural center, and we must earn the public's trust.
lines.zh: 很好。市长在就职演说中承诺让这座日渐衰败的文化中心重获生机，我们必须赢得公众的信任。

lines.en: As a sociologist, I am helping residents tell their own history. Our restored film includes footage of a presidential inaugural that many local families attended.
lines.zh: 作为社会学家，我正在帮助居民讲述自己的历史。我们修复的影片中，有许多本地家庭参加总统就职典礼的影像。

lines.en: The council's monetary contribution covers the film restoration. We can keep tickets affordable if the benefit event succeeds.
lines.zh: 市议会的资金捐助支付了影片修复费用。如果这次公益活动成功，我们就能继续让票价保持亲民。

lines.en: I will spearhead the fundraising campaign. Leo, hang the silver ornament donated by the founder's family, and ornament the entrance with flowers.
lines.zh: 我来带头组织筹款活动。利奥，请挂上创办人家属捐赠的银饰，并用鲜花装饰入口。

lines.en: The lights and projector will come on simultaneously. Then we can check the display cases before the guests arrive.
lines.zh: 灯光和放映机会同时启动。之后我们就能在来宾到达前检查展柜。

lines.en: Wait. These donation certificates are counterfeit, and the silver ornament may be a counterfeit too. The maker's mark looks wrong.
lines.zh: 等等。这些捐赠证书是伪造的，那件银饰也可能是赝品。制造者的印记不对。

lines.en: Someone who can counterfeit a certificate could also falsify a receipt. We should compare the delivery records before making an accusation.
lines.zh: 能伪造证书的人也可能伪造收据。在提出指控前，我们应该先核对送货记录。

lines.en: The new donor kept trying to insinuate himself into our planning committee. Now his assistant is trying to insinuate that Ben took the missing restoration money.
lines.zh: 那位新捐赠人一直设法混进我们的筹备委员会。现在他的助理又在暗示本挪用了失踪的修复资金。

lines.en: Do not let that rumor tarnish Ben's reputation. First we must remove the tarnish from the genuine comparison piece so Leo can examine its stamp clearly.
lines.zh: 不要让那个传言损害本的名誉。我们得先擦掉真品对照物上的暗锈，让利奥看清它的印记。

lines.en: The donor has become truculent. He demands access to the archive and threatens to withdraw the donation if we question him.
lines.zh: 那位捐赠人变得十分蛮横。他要求进入档案室，并威胁说，如果我们追问，他就撤回捐赠。

lines.en: His long explanation seems designed to obfuscate the issue. The archive log, not his speech, will tell us who entered the room.
lines.zh: 他那一长串解释像是有意混淆问题。能说明谁进过房间的是档案出入记录，而不是他的说辞。

lines.en: There is more missing than money. A delivery crate has a gaping hole, and the master copy of the film is gone.
lines.zh: 丢失的不只是钱。一个运输箱裂开了一个大洞，影片母版也不见了。

lines.en: A paparazzo outside has photographed the open crate. Guests are starting to gape at the screen showing the photograph.
lines.zh: 外面一名狗仔摄影师拍到了敞开的箱子。来宾们开始目瞪口呆地看着屏幕上那张照片。

lines.en: That crowd could turn into a stampede. Leo, keep the exit clear and tell everyone there is no fire.
lines.zh: 那群人可能突然蜂拥奔逃。利奥，保持出口畅通，告诉大家没有发生火灾。

lines.en: Someone shouted that the building was unsafe, and several guests stampeded toward the doors. We have stopped the rush without blocking the exits.
lines.zh: 有人大喊大楼不安全，几位来宾便蜂拥着冲向门口。我们没有堵住出口，已经制止了这阵奔逃。

lines.en: Please segregate the damaged exhibit from the visitor area, but do not treat frightened guests as troublemakers.
lines.zh: 请把受损展品和参观区域隔开，但不要把受惊的来宾当成闹事者。

lines.en: The statutory safety inspection was completed yesterday. I can show the certificate while the engineer checks the crate and display stand.
lines.zh: 法定安全检查昨天已经完成。工程师检查箱子和展架时，我可以出示证书。

lines.en: The police recognize the donor: he is a fugitive from justice. They have jurisdiction over the theft, although the hall lies within the jurisdiction of the town council.
lines.zh: 警方认出了那位捐赠人：他是一名在逃犯。警方对盗窃案有管辖权，不过礼堂所在区域属于镇议会的管辖范围。

lines.en: A volunteer has collapsed. A psychiatrist who works with our outreach team is helping her, and a physician will check for any morbid condition behind the fainting.
lines.zh: 一名志愿者晕倒了。我们外展团队合作的精神科医生正在照看她，另有一位内科医生会检查晕厥背后是否存在病理性状况。

lines.en: No photographs of the patient, please. Morbid curiosity will only make this harder for her. Give her privacy and time to recuperate.
lines.zh: 请不要拍摄患者。对病痛的猎奇只会让她更难受。给她隐私，也给她时间恢复健康。

lines.en: The security backup vindicates my account: I left before the donor entered. The bank also froze his transfer, so the hall can recuperate its losses.
lines.zh: 监控备份证实了我的说法：捐赠人进去前我就离开了。银行也冻结了他的转账，因此礼堂能够挽回损失。

lines.en: Police found the film in his van. His partner says their hedonistic lifestyle had left them desperate for money; that explains the scheme, but does not excuse it.
lines.zh: 警方在他的货车里找到了影片。他的同伙说，追求享乐的生活让他们急需钱；这能解释这场骗局，却不能成为借口。

lines.en: The recovered film follows a fugitive man who escaped slavery. The archive calls him a fugitive slave; we will explain that this historical label describes the injustice he faced.
lines.zh: 找回的影片讲述了一位逃离奴役、四处逃亡的男子。档案称他为“逃亡奴隶”；我们会解释，这个历史称谓反映了他所遭受的不公。

lines.en: Then we must vindicate his family's rights to tell that story. We cannot let a sensational headline replace their testimony.
lines.zh: 那么，我们必须维护他家属讲述这段历史的权利。我们不能让耸人听闻的标题取代他们的证言。

lines.en: His letters describe the plague that closed the old port and the political ferment that followed. That is why residents founded this hall as a place to meet safely.
lines.zh: 他的信件记述了导致旧港口关闭的瘟疫，以及此后发生的政治动荡。这正是居民们创办这座礼堂、希望有个安全聚会场所的原因。

lines.en: The port workers also ran a cooperative bakery. This recipe says to let the dough ferment overnight. We can tell that part of the story through the food we serve.
lines.zh: 港口工人们还办过一家合作面包房。这份食谱说，要让面团发酵一夜。我们可以通过供应的食物讲述这部分历史。

lines.en: The technical faults that plagued our rehearsal are fixed. Let us test the recovered film and invite the family to approve the introduction.
lines.zh: 排练时一直困扰我们的技术故障已经修好了。我们来测试找回的影片，并请家属审核开场介绍。

lines.en: A throng of residents is waiting outside. By sunset the courtyard will be thronged with people, so we will admit each group slowly.
lines.zh: 一大群居民正在外面等候。日落时庭院就会挤满人，我们会让大家分批、缓慢入场。

lines.en: Tonight's premiere can finally begin. The restored documentary will premiere here before it travels to the regional film festival.
lines.zh: 今晚的首映终于可以开始了。这部修复后的纪录片将在这里首次公映，随后再送往地区电影节。

lines.en: The volunteers became the spearhead of this rescue. They protected the visitors, recovered the archive, and let the family speak for themselves.
lines.zh: 志愿者们成为这次救援的先锋。他们保护了来宾，找回了档案，也让家属亲自讲述自己的故事。

lines.en: I repent of trusting that donor's papers without checking them. I owe the volunteers an apology for making their work harder.
lines.zh: 我后悔没有核实就相信了那位捐赠人的文件。让志愿者们的工作变得更困难，我应该向他们道歉。

lines.en: I accept your apology. Our reconciliation matters more than a perfect opening night: this hall exists so people can listen to one another.
lines.zh: 我接受你的道歉。我们的和解比一场完美的开幕之夜更重要：这座礼堂存在的意义，就是让人们能彼此倾听。

lines.en: Then let us lower the lights. The audience is ready, the family is here, and Riverside Hall has a future again.
lines.zh: 那么，就让我们调暗灯光吧。观众已经就座，家属也已到场，河畔礼堂终于重新拥有了未来。
